problem.title: Social shouldn't be this hard

howItWorks.title: Three steps to your people
howItWorks.step1Desc: Tell the Agent what you want to do and who you're looking for, just like <highlight>chatting with a friend</highlight>.
howItWorks.step2Desc: The Agent grasps your <highlight>real needs</highlight> and preferences, not just surface-level info.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Get <highlight>precise recommendations</highlight> of people or events that fit, with conversation starters ready.
